resources.string: Bandhanhara Bangla · Big keys, smart suggestions, made for Bangla
Turn on “বাঁধনহারা বাংলা” in the system keyboard list.
Pick বাঁধনহারা বাংলা as your current keyboard. You can switch back any time with the 🌐 key.

Tap ক for ক, hold it for খ. Every aspirate pair works this way: গ→ঘ, চ→ছ, জ→ঝ, ট→ঠ, ত→থ, দ→ধ, প→ফ, ব→ভ, স→শ, ন→ণ. Vowels too: hold অ for আ, ি for ী.

The vowel row changes by itself: after a consonant it shows vowel signs (া ি ু), otherwise full vowels (অ ই উ). Tap its left key to switch by hand.

যুক্তাক্ষর: type the first letter, then ্ (end of the third row), then the next letter — ক ্ ত = ক্ত. For ফলা after a consonant, tap ্র or ্য in the vowel row: ক ্য = ক্য, প ্র = প্র. Hold ্র for ৃ (কৃ). য় and ষ are on the first screen; ং is in the vowel row.

⇧ opens rare letters, conjuncts and digits for one key; tap twice to lock. !?# opens symbols; hold it for emoji. Hold । for a comma.

🌐 switches between বাংলা and English. Hold 🌐 to pick another keyboard.

The strip above the keys suggests words and learns yours. Its ⊞ button opens emoji, clipboard, voice typing and settings.

Drag along the space bar to move the cursor. Hold ⌫ to delete whole words. Tap space twice to end a sentence.

The keyboard remembers the words and phrases you use, so its suggestions get better over time. Words you stop using fade out, and a suggestion you pick and then delete is shown less. Everything stays on this phone.
Suggestions go back to the built-in dictionary. This can\'t be undone.
Emoji you use show up here.
Text you copy shows up here for an hour. Tap to paste, hold to remove.
No voice typing is installed. Install Google voice typing to use the microphone.
Show the held character in the corner of each key
Completions and next-word predictions above the keys
Punctuation typed next takes the space back
Ends the sentence and adds a space
A capital at the start of each sentence
Show a large letter above the key while pressed
